approach: Write the total displacement as the sum of the three constant-velocity legs, divide by the total time to set it equal to the given average velocity, and solve for T.

steps.text: Write the displacement covered in each of the three legs of the journey.
steps.equation: leg 1: v t₀, leg 2: 2v t₀, leg 3: 3v T

steps.text: Add these for the total displacement and add the three times for the total time.
steps.equation: total displacement = 3v t₀ + 3vT, total time = 2t₀ + T

steps.text: Set the total displacement over the total time equal to the given average velocity of 2.5v.
Cancel v and solve the resulting linear equation for T.

common_mistakes.text: Leaving out the displacement of the first leg, v t₀, from the total when setting up the equation gives T = 6t₀.
